newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom buys 1.2 mln shrs at $6.62-6.74 ps.
newsitem.headline: Telecom buys 1.2 mln shrs at $6.62-6.74 ps.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand said on Monday it had bought back 1.2 million ordinary shares on Friday, at prices ranging from NZ$6.62 to $6.74 per share.
The total number of issued shares following the acquisition of shares that day is 1.89 billion.

Telecom said last November it planned a NZ$1 billion share repurchase programme over one year starting in the fourth quarter of its 1996/97 fiscal year. Half the shares would be purchased on the New Zealand and New York stock exchanges and the other half directly from Ameritech and Bell Atlantic, which each own a quarter of the company.
The shares closed on Friday at $6.60 per share.
